label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: Marketplace released on 16 Oct: all 33 Ready for Prod items moved to Done, including security and privacy testing (MT-1547, MT-1553), payment callbacks (MT-1544) and the RMA fixes. Smoke testing (MT-1541), RMA item-level decisions (MT-1540) and the live chat widget (MT-1577 to MT-1580) closed with them, and the Playwright test repository (MT-1612) was set up. 46 Marketplace items closed that day and no bug is open. The Magento 2.4.9 upgrade (MT-1615) started: it now has 91 module subtasks, 51 of them unassigned. Chatbot integration (MT-1626) is in progress. 15 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: Marketing started the October 2nd Sprint after the 15 Oct release: the Sonar clean-up (MR-1073), Microsoft Bookings to replace Calendly (MR-1362) and cross-browser automation testing (MR-1358) are in progress, and the H1-tag task (MR-1361) moved to In Prod1. Kannan Elangovan added automated smoke testing of every sitemap URL (MR-1369) and three page bugs for Kunal Jangid (MR-1371 to MR-1373, due 30 Oct). 8 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Past-due work rose from 100 to 117 as 17 items due 15 Oct stayed open. Invoice issuing from the CRM (USP-4284, USP-4287 to USP-4289, Cășvan Marcel) and the team roster and chat stories (USP-4296, USP-4297, USP-4312 to USP-4315, Silviu Oltean) have not started, and seven front-end fixes (five of them Akhil Katiyar's) sit in code review, Dev or Ready for Production. Two proforma payment subtasks (USP-4285, USP-4286) were deployed to Dev and two CRM product updates (USP-4245, USP-4251) closed. The S1 bugs (USP-4231, USP-4204) and the Highest security bug with no due date (USP-4369) remain open.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: The live agent console and handoff queue (UC-21, Ankit Saxena, due 20 Oct) started on 16 Oct with its build and design subtasks (UC-41, UC-84). A follow-on Marketplace sign-in story (UC-235, Nareddy Shiva Prasad Reddy, due 19 Oct) is in progress with two subtasks in Dev Testing; the first one (UC-225) closed on 15 Oct. Shivam Dhoundiyal started the CSM dashboard redesign (UC-237; UC-238 due 26 Oct). 26 items are past due.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: Three Pulse stories held by Naveen Jangid (PULSE-9 to PULSE-11: CI build, on-prem deployment and service health) moved back from In Progress to To Do on 16 Oct. Sarath Chandra finished moving Pulse to the on-prem VM (IN-1125), and a deployment pipeline for it is planned (IN-1165). Anshul Bhargava's Interactive AI Factory tasks sit on the PRD board, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: The CRM build plan arrived on 16 Oct: 285 new tickets, 273 raised by Shashi Prasad K, with 47 stories in nine milestones from M0 (repository, AKS environments, Entra ID sign-in, multi-tenancy) to M8 (go-live readiness and a pilot with the Uvation sales team) and 238 subtasks. 267 are unassigned and 283 have no due date. The R&D item (ATLAS-1) and the prototype work (ATLAS-4, ATLAS-7, ATLAS-8) closed, and Saurabh Jain is preparing the end-to-end Gmail lead flow for a 22 October demo (ATLAS-282).

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: Account deactivation and GDPR deletion (ID-747) closed on 16 Oct with all eight subtasks, and the company-details bug (ID-733) closed. The account-deletion front end (ID-743, ID-744, ID-756), the session clean-up (ID-714) and an MFA fix (ID-713) are in UAT but passed their 15 Oct due date, so past-due rose from 6 to 11. Five tasks were added, including the Teams tenant and Azure Communication service for the production chatbot (ID-763, ID-766).

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 16 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: Sarath Chandra moved Pulse to the on-prem VM: the migration (IN-1125) and its four subtasks closed on 16 Oct. b.kumar planned the October 2nd Sprint with 19 new items: pipelines moving to AKS agents (IN-1157), Snyk image scanning (IN-1161, k.kishore), the Pulse on-prem pipeline (IN-1165) and OpenTelemetry and AKS log monitoring (IN-1169). 15 items still sit in BLOCKER status and 22 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: The H1-tag fix (DM-1091) moved to review and the soft 404 fix (DM-1074) closed on 16 Oct. The portal HTTPS fix (DM-1090) and the 404 work (DM-1082) are still in review. 28 items are past due.
